plan_item: 77.44.7.B — mixed Rich Text link target lifecycle
finding: When a selection covered links with different targets, readRichTextLinkTarget silently returned Auto. The Inspector then hid the mixed state, and changing only the URL overwrote the per-run _self/_blank choices.
change: The Inspector now displays a disabled mixed-target state instead of claiming Auto when selected runs differ.
URL edits made with the mixed state preserve every existing run target; unlinked selected text follows safe URL defaults, and every _blank link receives noopener noreferrer.
The shared link updater still validates URL schemes and rejects arbitrary target values.
